description: This file provides functions to detect and execute system commands for opening URLs in a browser, supporting multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, WSL). It includes platform detection, command resolution, and functions to open URLs in foreground and background.

methods.name: shouldSkipBrowserOpenInTests
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if browser opening should be skipped during tests.

methods.name: resolveBrowserOpenCommand
methods.description: Determines the appropriate command to open a URL based on the current platform and environment.

methods.name: detectBrowserOpenSupport
methods.description: Checks if the system supports opening URLs with the resolved command.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in the default browser, with optional quoting, unless skipped during tests.

methods.name: openUrlInBackground
methods.description: Opens a URL in the background on macOS, unless skipped during tests.
